thesis.core: 2026H1 headline profit decline is dominated by an exceptional FX swing rather than a break in the operating franchise. Ex-FX profit before tax grew about 4.8%, automotive-glass and float-glass gross margins improved, the mix of high-value-added products rose materially, and operating cash flow remained above reported attributable profit. The core global auto-glass quality thesis remains intact and has modestly strengthened on mix and margin evidence.
thesis.variant_wedge: The current price discounts weak headline H1 earnings, slower overseas growth and FX volatility, but it underweights the resilience of underlying operating profit, high-value-product mix expansion and cash conversion. The rerating ceiling should still be disciplined because global auto production and overseas growth are not strong enough to justify a high-growth multiple.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use RMB3.75 2026E normalized EPS as the base, slightly below the 21-institution consensus mean of RMB3.78 and inside the observed RMB3.34-4.12 range. Bear/base/bull EPS of RMB3.35/RMB3.75/RMB4.10 deliberately avoid annualizing H1 FX noise and preserve downside for slower overseas revenue and auto-production growth.

financial_quality.judgment: Reported net profit is weak because of the FX reversal, but underlying operating quality is intact: product gross margins improved, mix upgraded and CFO remained about 1.15x reported attributable profit. Expansion and refinancing raised gross borrowing activity, so debt/capex discipline remains a monitoring item rather than a current thesis break.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base EPS is set just below current consensus and normalized for H1 FX noise; scenario EPS spans the current institutional range while allowing for slower overseas growth.

catalysts: High-value-added glass penetration continues to lift ASP and gross margin without sacrificing share.
Domestic auto demand stabilizes while new domestic capacity and U.S. production optimization support H2 shipment growth.
Operating cash flow remains close to or above normalized earnings despite expansion capex.
The RMB1.00 per-share interim cash dividend is implemented while balance-sheet liquidity remains comfortable.
kill_thesis: Automotive-glass market share or gross margin deteriorates materially for more than one reporting period, indicating franchise erosion rather than FX noise.
Ex-FX operating profit turns materially negative year on year despite continued high-value-product mix expansion.
U.S. or other overseas revenue/profit deterioration becomes structural because of customer, tariff, execution or competitive issues.
Capex, borrowing and working-capital absorption push free-cash-flow conversion structurally negative or materially weaken balance-sheet flexibility.

d2_answers.question: Did the H1 headline profit decline break the operating thesis?
d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 attributable profit fell 17.37%, but the company disclosed an RMB0.803bn FX loss versus an RMB0.602bn FX gain a year earlier; excluding the FX swing, profit before tax increased about 4.78%. Automotive-glass gross margin rose 1.55 percentage points and high-value-product mix rose 8.03 percentage points.

d2_answers.question: Is the price trigger alone sufficient for ADD?
d2_answers.assumption: Bear/base/bull values are RMB43.55/RMB63.75/RMB82.00 at 25%/50%/25%, using normalized 2026E EPS of RMB3.35/RMB3.75/RMB4.10 and 13x/17x/20x P/E.
d2_answers.judgment: YES_FOR_RESEARCH_ACTION. RMB53.68 IS BELOW THE RMB55.01 15PCT_HURDLE_ENTRY_AND OFFERS ABOUT 17.9PCT PROBABILITY_WEIGHTED UPSIDE, WHILE BEAR DOWNSIDE REMAINS ABOUT 18.9PCT.

d2_answers.question: Portfolio action?
d2_answers.judgment: Upgrade the existing simulation holding from HOLD to ADD at the research layer. Do not mutate the protected simulation account automatically; Phase3 must determine the executable quantity under single-name, risk-group and round-lot constraints.

evidence_gap.missing: No material primary-evidence gap for the H1 operating thesis. 2026H2 earnings, overseas growth and FX remain forecast uncertainties rather than missing historical evidence.
evidence_gap.recovery: Refresh on the next quarterly filing, a material overseas/margin/cash-conversion event, or a governed valuation trigger.
